name: inspira-animated-tooltip

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the full-size tilted tooltip with name and role while the whole avatar row stays in view.

tagline: Overlapping face row; hovering one pops a tilted name card.
summary: A row of overlapping circular portraits with white rings. Hovering a face springs a black tooltip above it with the person's name and role, tilting and sliding as the pointer moves sideways.
appearance: Five small round portraits overlap left to right, each ringed in thick white, on a dark stage. A hovered face lifts a small black rounded card above it holding a bold white name, a dimmer role line and a thin green-to-blue gradient edge.
behaviour: Entering a face hides the others' cards and springs its own up from below. Moving the cursor across the face rotates and shifts the card, and leaving drops it away again.
demo_content: Prompt 'Hover over the avatars' with five portraits: Sarah Chen, Marcus Johnson, Priya Patel and two others.
search_phrases: overlapping avatars with names on hover
team members row with name tooltip
profile picture stack that reveals details
tooltip that tilts with the cursor
meet the team avatars for about page
avatar group for a blog author list
use_when: A compact team or contributor row should reveal each person's name and role without leaving the page.
avoid_when: Names appear on mouse hover only, so touch and keyboard users never see who anyone is.
customise: items takes an id, name, designation and image per person; the tilt strength, spring and tooltip colours live in the source.
weight_why: Five images and a single spring tooltip; nothing runs until a pointer enters.

a11y.note: Each photo has alt text, but the hover target is a plain div with no tab stop, so keyboard users cannot open the tooltip.

issues: Tooltips on the end avatars spill past the row, and in frames 2 and 4 they sit over the prompt text.
polish_why: Crisp avatar row and a playful cursor-tilted card; end tooltips overhang their neighbours.
